# Discoverability — GitHub Settings Guide

Copy-paste values for GitHub → Settings → About. Topics cannot be set via code, so apply these manually.

## About

**Description:**

```text
AI-powered Stremio addon for movie & TV recommendations (Gemini, Perplexity, OpenAI) — BYOK, self-hosted
```

**Website:**

```text
—
```

Leave blank for now — add a hosted instance URL only when you have one. Not required.

## Topics

Set these 10 topics (Settings → About → Topics). Keep `stremio-addon` as the primary topic:

- stremio
- stremio-addon
- ai
- ai-recommendations
- gemini
- perplexity
- openai
- movies
- tv-series
- docker

## Why this matters

GitHub search and topic pages drive most organic discovery for Stremio addons. Matching the `package.json` keywords (`stremio`, `stremio-addon`, `ai`, …) with these repository topics means a single search for “stremio addon ai recommendations” surfaces this repo, its npm listing, and its docs together.
